# Baidu Netdisk for DeepSeek Harness
简体中文
Connect DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service. This community plugin registers th
e service's SSE tools in DSH. Each user authorizes their own Baidu account.
## Install and authorize
1. Install in the DSH profile you use. Replace `desktop` with your profile name if needed.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
2. Open the official authorization guide and follow the account authorization steps. The individual-

account application is a limited trial. Baidu may change its availability or credentials.
3. Run the
local prompt below. Copy the complete address of the official Baidu success page into the hidden pr
ompt, then press Enter. A new authorization replaces the previous one. Restart the DSH profile and a
sk it to check your Baidu Netdisk capacity.
Windows PowerShell:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
macOS/Linux:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The helper requires Node.js 22 or later. It saves the token under `~/.dsh-baidu-netdisk/`. Windows e
ncrypts it with user-scoped DPAPI. On macOS and Linux, the helper creates the directory and token fi
le with user-only permissions. You can set `DSH_BAIDU_NETDISK_CREDENTIAL_DIR` in both processes to c
hoose a different private directory. Never paste the token or success URL into an agent chat or a pr
ofile file. Revoke access via Baidu's account authorization page.
## Available tools
The plugin filters the tools advertised by the official service. As of 2026-11-02, it discovered 13
tools by default and 23 with writes enabled. Tools use the `mcp__baidu_netdisk__` prefix.
| Mode | Capabilities |
| Default | List files by type, get metadata and content, search by keyword or meaning, read account

and quota, inspect share contents, verify share codes, and check share task status |
| With writes
enabled | Create folders and documents, copy, move, rename, create shares, transfer shared files, an
d request upload by URL or text |
The optional `file_upload` tool produces a draft for Baidu's separate `bdpan` CLI. The plugin does n
ot install or run that CLI. Use Baidu's own instructions for local-file uploads. The tools exposed t
o an account depend on Baidu's authorization and service responses.
To enable write tools, set `enableWrites` for this plugin in DSH, or apply this profile patch and re
ble write tools, set `enableWrites` for this plugin in DSH, or apply this profile patch and restart:

DSH prompts for approval on each write call. Profiles without an approval channel deny the call.
